title: Cartan--Eilenberg resolution properties for a bounded-below complex
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with enough injectives, let $K^\bullet$ be a bounded-below complex, and let $C^{\bullet,\bullet}$ be a Cartan--Eilenberg resolution in the following exchanged-index convention (Stacks Project's $I^{p,q}$ is $C^{q,p}$): it is a double complex with differentials $d_I:C^{p,q}\to C^{p+1,q}$ and $d_{II}:C^{p,q}\to C^{p,q+1}$, together with an augmentation $K^\bullet\to C^{0,\bullet}$, such that (1) there is $i$ with $C^{p,q}=0$ for all $q<i$ and all $p$; (2) $C^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$; (3) for every $q$, the row $(C^{\bullet,q},d_I)$ augmented by $K^q$ is an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of $K^q$; (4) for every $q$, the complex $\operatorname{Ker}(d_{II}:C^{\bullet,q}\to C^{\bullet,q+1})$ is an injective resolution of $Z^q(K^\bullet)$; (5) for every $q$, the complex $\operatorname{Im}(d_{II}:C^{\bullet,q}\to C^{\bullet,q+1})$ is an injective resolution of $B^{q+1}(K^\bullet)$; and (6) for every $q$, the complex $H^q_{II}(C^{\bullet,\bullet})$ is an injective resolution of $H^q(K^\bullet)$. Then for every left exact additive functor $G$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $H^q_{II}(G(C^{p,\bullet}))=G(H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet}))$. For every $q$, the complex $(H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet}))_p$ with differential induced by $d_I$ is an injective resolution of $H^q(K^\bullet)$.

proof.text: Start with the Cartan--Eilenberg resolution in Stacks Definition 015H and exchange the two indices as specified in the statement. The row in the exchanged convention is the original column, so each row is an injective resolution of $K^q$. The original row conditions say that, in each exchanged column, the cycle, boundary, and cohomology objects are injective; the differential on these objects is induced by the differential of $K^\bullet$. The bounded-below and first-quadrant conditions are unchanged by this reindexing.

For a fixed exchanged column, apply the left-exact cohomology comparison of [lem-sp-cart-eilenberg-left-exact-cohomology] to the complex $C^{p,\bullet}$. Its hypotheses hold because the cycle and boundary objects of every such column are injective by Step 1. Therefore $H^q_{II}(G(C^{p,\bullet}))=G(H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet}))$ for every $p,q$.

The final Cartan--Eilenberg condition in Definition 015H, after exchanging indices, says that the complex in the first index formed by the vertical cohomology objects $H^q_{II}(C^{p,\bullet})$ is an injective resolution of $H^q(K^\bullet)$, with differential induced by $d_I$. This gives the asserted resolution for every $q$.

lean.statement: theorem cartanEilenberg_properties {B : Type u} [Category.{v} B] [Abelian B] [EnoughInjectives B] {A : Type u'} [Category.{v'} A] [Abelian A] (K : CochainComplex B ℤ) (C : HomologicalComplex₂ B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (a : K ⟶ C.X 0) (hK : ∃ i : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < i → IsZero (K.X q)) (hbelow : ∃ i : ℤ, ∀ p q : ℤ, q < i → IsZero ((C.X p).X q)) (hnegative : ∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero ((C.X p).X q)) (G : B ⥤ A) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] : let P := C.restriction ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat let R := HomologicalComplex₂.flip P ∀ (hrows : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (I : InjectiveResolution (K.X q)) (e : I.cocomplex ≅ R.X q), (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.X q)).inv ≫ I.ι.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 = a.f q) (hcycles : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (I : InjectiveResolution (K.cycles q)) (e : I.cocomplex ≅ kernel (R.d q (q + 1))), (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.cycles q)).inv ≫ I.ι.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 ≫ (kernel.ι (R.d q (q + 1))).f 0 = K.iCycles q ≫ a.f q) (hboundaries : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (I : InjectiveResolution (image (K.d q (q + 1)))) (e : I.cocomplex ≅ image (R.d q (q + 1))), (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (image (K.d q (q + 1)))).inv ≫ I.ι.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 ≫ (image.ι (R.d q (q + 1))).f 0 = image.ι (K.d q (q + 1)) ≫ a.f (q + 1)) (hhomology : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (I : InjectiveResolution (K.homology q)) (e : I.cocomplex ≅ ((homologyFunctor B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj P), (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.homology q)).inv ≫ I.ι.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 = homologyMap a q), (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (C.X p)).homology q) ≅ G.obj ((C.X p).homology q))) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (I : InjectiveResolution (K.homology q)) (e : I.cocomplex ≅ ((homologyFunctor B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj P), (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.homology q)).inv ≫ I.ι.f 0 ≫ e.hom.f 0 = homologyMap a q)
lean.note: Integer-indexed commuting bicomplex. Its nonnegative first-degree restriction uses Mathlib InjectiveResolution; kernel and image are computed in the abelian category of natural-indexed cochain complexes. The equality of cohomology objects is rendered as existence of an isomorphism, as usual for categorical objects defined by universal properties.
